newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Lion says NZ beer market share at 54 pct.
newsitem.headline: Lion says NZ beer market share at 54 pct.

text.p: Lion Nathan Ltd said on Thursday its share of the New Zealand beer market fell slightly in the first half of fiscal 1995/96 but had stabilised in the second half at around 54 percent.
"Like the Australian operations, New Zealand liquor is also operating in an increasingly competitive environment, featuring pricing pressure from cheap imported beers and micro breweries."
New Zealand liquor continued to generate robust earnings with total sales of $585 million in the year to August 31 against $584 million the previous year.
New Zealand liquor's market share fell to 54 percent from 54.4 percent at the same time last year.
Earlier the company reported a net profit of $150.4 million in the August year.
